title: NJ Talingting
text:
I build open-source softwares to resolve the “Continental Fallacy”— the geographic bias that treats our oceans as barriers rather than vital conductors of connectivity in spatial modeling.
While studying Statistics in Cebu— situated beside the Philippines’ busiest maritime hub— I witnessed the gap between logistical reality and spatial data. This exposure has eventually led me to developing tools indexed to the Comprehensive R Archive Network (CRAN) while being an appointed public official since 2023.
Beyond code, I lead and maintain PinasR, a centralized registry for Filipino-led R developers so that the future generation would hopefully not feel the isolation I’ve felt during my early days as maintainer. I also love reading fiction books! I pride myself in reading Dan Brown’s books in one sitting.
